description: Sticky, keyboard-aware primary button pinned to the footer. Disabled until the form is valid; shows an inline loading label while saving.

isValid.description: amount finite && category selected && (not monthly-expense || dueDay 1-31)

disabledReason.description: SR-announced reason, e.g. 'enter an amount and pick a category'

behavior: Wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView so it stays above the keyboard. On success: successHaptic() + router.back(). On failure: errorHaptic() + show InlineErrorCard, re-enable. Replaces all Alert.alert validation with proactive disabled state.
